title: Vasco da Gama reaches India by sea
summary: The Portuguese fleet of Vasco da Gama arrived near Calicut on the Malabar Coast after sailing around Africa, guided across the Indian Ocean by a local pilot.
reason: Portugal had spent decades exploring the African coast to reach the spice markets of Asia without Venetian and Muslim middlemen.
significance: Opening the sea route to India began European maritime empires in Asia and reshaped world trade.
